papers.title: Constellation Design Thinking: Hybrid Pedagogies for Nonlinear Learning in Art and Design Education
papers.reason: The study measures cognitive flexibility and reflective reasoning in human students, but its core contribution is design pedagogy rather than modelling or assessment of executive function.

papers.title: Functional connectivity of reward and cognitive control networks predicts body mass index but not binge eating disorder in women
papers.reason: The paper appears to examine human cognitive control network connectivity in relation to BMI and binge eating, but executive function is likely secondary to obesity-related prediction.

papers.title: Spontaneously emerging patterns show category-biased similarity to task-evoked visual patterns beyond human visual cortex.
papers.reason: The title suggests general visual neuroscience about spontaneous and task-evoked category patterns, with no clear link to executive function modelling or cognitive assessment.

papers.title: Two minds, one body: neural correlates of processing of We-information during shared control over a humanoid robot
papers.reason: This human EEG study reports ERP effects involving action selection, working memory, response preparation, and covert attention during shared control, although the main framing is social self-processing.

papers.title: Body in memory: the role of bodily self-consciousness in episodic memory and autonoetic consciousness
papers.reason: The review discusses behavioural and neural mechanisms linking bodily self-consciousness to episodic memory and some working memory, but it is not centrally about executive function.

papers.title: The effects of smartphone presence during a reading task: a psychophysiological study
papers.reason: This human EEG, ECG, eye-tracking, and behavioural study directly examines attentional distraction, cognitive control demands, anxiety, and task performance during notification interference.

papers.title: Stress responses and emotion regulation through distraction in non-clinical students: a near-infrared spectroscopy study
papers.reason: The study uses NIRS and a sustained attention task to examine prefrontal activation, attentional control, inhibition, and emotion regulation under stress, with relevance to executive control mechanisms.

papers.title: What do voice and drawings recorded during the MMSE add to its score? A multicenter multimodal deep learning study of dementia screening.
papers.reason: This is a close applied match to multimodal digital biomarker work for dementia screening, using behavioural outputs recorded during a standard cognitive assessment.

papers.title: Beyond Pills: Moving Towards the Use of Virtual Bikes and Virtual Reality Headsets to Treat Depression in Elderly People with Cognitive Impairments in Care Homes
papers.reason: The review concerns virtual reality and exercise-bike interventions for depression in older adults with cognitive impairment, not executive function modelling or cognitive biomarker assessment.
